$comment: HO-835: the one declaration of a Task run plan's v2 contract rules — `requires` `service` and `precondition` entries, a `file` entry's `access`, and the top-level `rehearsal` block — plus every reason text they fail with. HO-839: `rehearsalCapS`, `rehearsalScopes` and `rehearsalReasons` are what a rehearsal of that block may take and say: farm/rehearsal.py emits only these reason ids and server/src/orchestrator.js stores only these, so the two cannot drift. Ids only, never copy. Read by domain/py/run_plan.py (the farm's validate() and unrehearsed()) and domain/js/runPlan.js (runPlanError(), the Approve the run card), so both bindings give the same words. A reason's `{slot}` is filled by each binding with a name, an index or a shape name, never a value from the plan. Each `writeShapes` pattern compiles in both Python `re` and JS `RegExp`; `ignoreCase` maps to re.I and the `i` flag; `unquotedOnly` tests the command with its quoted spans removed. The write-shape check is best-effort: it refuses obvious writes and cannot prove a command read-only. Nothing here ever runs a command.

reasons.access: run_plan 'requires' access must be 'r' or 'w', and only beside a 'file'
reasons.service: run_plan 'requires' service must be {"name", "version_cmd", "expect"} and nothing else: a name like postgresql, a one-line version_cmd and a one-line expect
reasons.precondition: run_plan 'requires' precondition must be {"kind", "check"} and nothing else: kind one of {kinds}, and a one-line check
reasons.writeShape: run_plan 'requires' {field} must be read-only, but it has a write shape ({shape})
reasons.dryRun: run_plan 'rehearsal.dry_run' must be a one-line, non-blank command
reasons.limit: run_plan 'rehearsal.limit' must be a whole number, at least 1
reasons.roEnv: run_plan 'rehearsal.ro_env' must be a list of distinct variable names like RO_DB_URL, with no `$`
reasons.roEnvLive: run_plan 'rehearsal.ro_env' name {name} is a live 'env' name; a read-only name must be a different one
reasons.samples: run_plan 'rehearsal.samples' must be a list of {"command": <k>, "expect": "<one expected line>"} objects
reasons.samplesCommand: run_plan 'rehearsal.samples' command must be a 1-based index into 'commands'
reasons.samplesDoubled: run_plan 'rehearsal.samples' names command {n} more than once
reasons.samplesExpect: run_plan 'rehearsal.samples' expect must be one non-blank line of at most {max} characters
reasons.unrehearsed: rehearsal.samples has no entry for proof {commands}
